description: Implementation of synchronization classes including CriticalSection, BinarySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event, with platform-specific code for Windows, POSIX, Linux, and Apple. Contains methods for interlocked operations, lock management, and event signaling.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: Encapsulates platform-specific critical section or mutex for thread synchronization.

classes.name: BinarySemaphore
classes.description: Implements a binary semaphore with platform-specific synchronization primitives.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a counting semaphore with platform-specific synchronization primitives.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Provides event signaling within process space, with manual or auto reset options.

classes.name: SharedSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a shared semaphore, supporting Windows HANDLE or POSIX sem_t.

methods.name: InterlockedIncrement
methods.description: Performs atomic increment on a variable, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: InterlockedDecrement
methods.description: Performs atomic decrement on a variable, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: CriticalSection::CriticalSection
methods.description: Constructor initializing platform-specific mutex or critical section.

methods.name: CriticalSection::~CriticalSection
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up platform-specific mutex or critical section.

methods.name: BinarySemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Acquires the binary semaphore, blocking indefinitely.

methods.name: BinarySemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the semaphore with a timeout.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the semaphore with a timeout.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Releases the semaphore, increasing the count.

methods.name: Event::SetEvent
methods.description: Signals the event, waking waiting threads.

methods.name: Event::ResetEvent
methods.description: Resets the event to non-signaled state.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled, blocking indefinitely.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Waits for the event with a timeout.
